title: Spotify Popularity Prediction
text:
The question
Why are some songs listened to by millions of people while some never make it out of someone’s basement? We hope to discover what effects various musical elements have on the popularity of a music track on Spotify, by looking at the level of popularity across the duration of the song, the key, the tempo, the genre, the time signature, and whether or not it is explicit. We believe that this analysis will help music producers make better business decisions, as well as well-known and aspiring artists to produce more popular songs. We will look at 114,000 individual Spotify music tracks on a dataset found on kaggle at https://doi.org/10.34740/kaggle/dsv/4372070. It is necessary to note that the exact process at which songs were given a popularity score is based on an algorithm not clearly defined, but involves the total number of plays and how recent those plays are. We are not sure exactly how the scores were produced or if they are 100% accurate, but we will work as if they are.
